sloka: तत्र मातृष्वसेयस्ते भ्राता ऽयं वै खरः प्रभुः ।भविष्यति तवादेशं सदा कुर्वन्निशाचरः ।। ७.२४.३७ ॥
transliteration: tatra mātṛṣvaseyaste bhrātā 'yaṁ vai kharaḥ prabhuḥ ।bhaviṣyati tavādeśaṁ sadā kurvanniśācaraḥ ।। 7.24.37 ॥

translations.english: There, your cousin and brother Khara, the lordly night-wanderer, will always execute your commands.
